I’m not sure whose responsibility it is to correct the incompatibility, but the fact that DynamicMaps uses custom library files add at the core EscapeFromTarkov_Data/Managed level makes me suspect that the issue is more on DynamicMaps’ end than NarcoNet.

I would have filed an issue on the GitHub page for DynamicMaps, but unfortuately the linked fork has “Issues” disabled. I’d love to use the DynamicMaps mod in my SPT setup, but I have a few friends I play with on a shared server and NarcoNet helps a lot with keeping our mods in sync, so removing it is not an option.

Link to NarcoNet’s mod page: https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2441/narconet-mod-sync Link to NarcoNet’s GitLab Repo: https://gitlab.com/flir063-spt/narconet
